name: ledger
description: /ledger prints each task ledger's goal, current step and next step; /ledger:task starts a separate task with its own worktree and ledger; /ledger:update writes the latest results to the ledger; /ledger:close writes the ledger and clears the session; /ledger:next does the same, then continues the task in the new session; /ledger:go <slug> does the same, then continues in the task named <slug>; /ledger:worktrees prints each linked git worktree's size, last commit, dirty files, ledger and PR; /ledger:retire archives a task's ledger and removes its worktree; /ledger:help lists these commands
